title: November 2024 Treasury coupon auctions: announced sizes and tentative schedule (as of 2024-10-31)
text:
November 2024 Treasury coupon auctions — announced terms and tentative schedule, as of 2024-10-31.
Source: U.S. Department of the Treasury / TreasuryDirect (October 30, 2024 quarterly refunding announcement; tentative auction schedule), public domain.

Announced on 2024-10-30 (sizes final):
- 3-Year Note, $58 billion, auction 2024-11-04, new issue.
- 10-Year Note, $42 billion, auction 2024-11-05, new issue.
- 30-Year Bond, $25 billion, auction 2024-11-06, new issue.
These sizes are unchanged from the prior quarter's refunding: Treasury stated it believes current auction sizes leave it well positioned and it does not anticipate needing to increase nominal coupon auction sizes for at least the next several quarters.

On the tentative schedule for later in November 2024 (sizes to be announced on 2024-11-14 and 2024-11-21):
- 20-Year Bond new issue scheduled for the week of 2024-11-18 (the new-issue month of its quarterly cycle).
- 2-Year, 5-Year, and 7-Year Notes scheduled for the week of 2024-11-25.
Recent practice has kept these sizes unchanged cycle over cycle (October 2024: 2-Year $69B, 5-Year $70B, 7-Year $44B; the most recent 20-Year new issue, August 2024, was $16B and its October reopening $13B).

Context: the November 2024 auction cycle spans the U.S. general election (2024-11-05) and the FOMC meeting concluding 2024-11-07.
